title: Test 9 — Detect a dying cell
agent_prompt: Detect a dying cell in the cell sample. Scan a specific area and identify a dying cell. Capture an image using the DAPI channel and the mScarlet channel, and create a single image from these two channels, circling the identified dying cell in the image. Display the final image in the napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
